memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: “We are His workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand.” Ephesians 2:10

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
You are not an accident. you are God’s intentional masterpiece. His Divine Design includes your personality, strengths, weaknesses, experiences, and seasons. Every joy and every tear has been woven into a greater purpose.
You are created in the image of God, a privilege given to no other creature ,not even angels. Angels serve, but you are designed to rule. Scripture says we will even judge angels and reign with Christ. You are not a slave; you are a co-ruler of God, seated with Christ in heavenly places.
This divine design declares your identity:
You are now a son and daughter of the Most High.
This blessing is so great that no human mind could have imagined it.
God not only designed you, He desired to dwell in you. And He fulfilled it by giving His Holy Spirit to live inside you. When you surrender and walk in obedience, His blueprint becomes your reality. You are uniquely crafted to fulfill a purpose no one else can complete.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: “God never does anything accidentally and He never makes mistakes.” Rick Warren

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You for designing my life with purpose and giving me the privilege of being Your child. Help me walk in Your authority, guided by Your Spirit who dwells within me. Lead me daily into Your perfect plan. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: May the Lord reveal the greatness of His design in you. May His Spirit empower you to walk as His chosen child and co-heir in Christ.
